changes.title: Four small faults seen on build 420
changes.detail:
Batch 58. None of the fixes has been seen in a browser yet.

- String builder: the note "kept as one template piece" stayed after that piece was removed. It now shows only while such a piece is among the pieces. - String builder on a phone: an empty strip sat under the buttons, because the sheet inherited the room kept for the floating bottom bar it covers. The sheet now keeps only the device's own safe-area inset. - Automation editor: a step scrolled to could land under the sticky search card, whose height varies. The card now publishes its real height as the scroll margin of the rows. - Navigation pane: with no saved order, the list of pages followed the order the server happened to register panels in, which is not stable, so two loads could differ. The default order is now fixed: the default page, dashboards by title, the built-in pages in their usual order, then the rest by title. A saved order is applied as before. A unit test covers it.

Checks: full suite 7,632 passed with the 3 known build-script failures; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors.
changes.detail_yue: 第 58 批，420 版睇到嘅四個小問題：字串建構器個提示唔識收返、手機底部 多咗條白邊、自動化編輯器跳去某一步會俾搜尋卡遮住、側欄頁面次序每次 載入可能唔同（因為跟伺服器註冊次序，而家排死咗）。未喺瀏覽器睇。

changes.title: Records: builds 418 to 420, what was seen by using them
changes.detail:
Documents only; no build is started by this push.

- Four passes used the published images for real, feature by feature, on throwaway instances. The notes now say what was seen working, which faults were found and fixed and seen right afterwards, what is still open, and what has still not been seen in any published build. - Every destructive confirmation that was reached asks for the two keys and the slider and has nothing to type. - The live instance moved to 418 at 04:50, 419 at 05:34 and 420 at 06:30 Toronto time, each after a browser pass on that exact image.
